paper_title: A microwave paraphoton and axion detection experiment with 300 dB electromagnetic shielding at 3 GHz
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi, dimensionless (plotted as Log10 chi)
notes: Microwave light-shining-through-wall experiment at CERN (March 2012), constraining hidden photon (paraphoton) kinetic mixing chi.
